versions.changelog:
- Initial release of muapi-media-generation skill.
- Generate AI images, videos, music, and audio directly from the terminal using muapi.ai.
- Supports 100+ models, including Flux, Midjourney v7, Kling 3.0, Veo3, and Suno V5.
- Includes scripts for text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video animation, music/audio creation, and file uploads.
- Provides flexible script flags and easy integration via environment variables.
